svg.title: Connecticut watershed foundation
svg.desc: Official subregional drainage polygons grouped into eight major basins. Includes source coverage beyond Connecticut. Colors identify geography, not drought risk.

g.text: 8 major drainage areas / 335 smaller watershed IDs / 374 polygon records
Colors show drainage areas, not drought risk. North is up.
Source: CT DEEP. Original coverage includes neighboring-state portions; state line is not shown.
Display boundaries simplified. Full-resolution shapes retained for analysis. No drought forecast yet.
